policy: Decided exclusions from the GT6 recipe-row progress target. Every rule needs an id, a reason and a decision (who decided / on what basis). Proven rows are never excluded. Rules are applied in order; the first matching rule wins. Match keys: classes, source_maps, blocker_keys, blocker_key_prefixes (blocker keys are listed in docs/current/gt6-full-coverage.md section 17). Adding a rule is a design decision: do not add one without the project owner's confirmation.

rules.reason: GT6 marks these rows fake or hidden: they only render in NEI (tool-head previews, bumblelyzer, byproduct lists). They are not RecipeMap recipes a machine executes; the behaviour they illustrate is tracked on the machine axis.
